emptyState.noActivePlans: No active membership for this learner.

changePlan.title: Change payment plan
changePlan.noChargeWarning: This applies immediately and takes no payment. The member keeps their current access window; the new price starts billing at their next renewal.
changePlan.loadFailed: We couldn't load the available plans. Please try again.
changePlan.noOptions: No other plan is marked switchable for this member. Turn on plan switching for a payment option in Settings → Payment Settings.
changePlan.alreadyInProgress: A plan change is already in progress for this membership.
changePlan.planNotActive: This membership isn't active, so its plan can't be changed.
changePlan.crossOptionNote: Also moves them onto the {{option}} enrolment invite — gateway, currency and auto-pay settings come from it.
changePlan.notifyLearner: Notify the member about this change

manualRenewal.title: Record manual renewal
manualRenewal.explainer: Record a renewal the member paid outside the platform. The membership (now {{status}}, ending {{date}}) becomes active again and its course access is extended to the date below.
manualRenewal.suggestedHint: Suggested: one full plan period ({{days}} days), from the current end date if it's still ahead, otherwise from today.
manualRenewal.remarksPlaceholder: e.g. Paid by bank transfer on 20 Oct, ref 7781
manualRenewal.remarksHint: Required. Visible to every admin in this membership's remarks history, with your name.
manualRenewal.generateInvoice: Generate an invoice for this payment
manualRenewal.sendEmail: Email the invoice / payment confirmation to the member
manualRenewal.noAutopay: Autopay is not turned on and nothing is charged automatically. The member is only emailed if you tick the box above.
manualRenewal.loadFailed: We couldn't load this membership. Please try again.

remarks.title: Membership remarks
remarks.placeholder: Add a remark for other admins…

endDate.title: Change membership end date
endDate.explainer: Moves when this membership ends (now {{date}}) without recording a payment. The member's course access moves to the same date. To bring back a lapsed membership, use Renew manually instead.
endDate.remarksPlaceholder: e.g. Paid on 7 Oct but enrolled on 23 Oct, so the year runs from 7 Oct
endDate.remarksHint: Required. Saved in this membership's remarks history with your name and the time.
endDate.failed: Could not change the end date
